params.prompt: Smooth high-end 3D render, square 1:1, dark warm background (#0B0907), split composition. LEFT HALF: a heavy, chaotic pile of paper invoices, folders, price tags, cables and web-page wireframe cards stacked in a tangled heap, matte grey-brown materials, dim cool light, feeling of expensive and complicated. RIGHT HALF: a single large glossy yellow (#FDD506) rounded keyboard key floating alone on clean dark space, softly lit, one warm glow beneath it, feeling of simple and effortless. A thin vertical gap of empty darkness between the halves. The top 30% of the frame is empty dark space for a title. No text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
